domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Publisher domains (for ads.txt) or app developer domains (for app-ads.txt), e.g. cnn.com.

fileType.title: File
fileType.description: ads.txt for websites, app-ads.txt for mobile and CTV apps, or both.

verifySellers.title: Verify sellers against sellers.json
verifySellers.description: Download each ad system's sellers.json once and check every seller id: found or not, seller type vs. DIRECT/RESELLER, seller name and domain. Slower: big files like Google's take 10-30 s to load.

maxSellersFiles.title: Max sellers.json files
maxSellersFiles.description: How many ad systems to verify, most-used first. Entries beyond this are marked unverifiable.

includeEntries.title: Include every line
includeEntries.description: Add the parsed entries (up to 3,000 per file) to each row. Turn off for summary-only rows.

maxRows.title: Max files per run
maxRows.description: Cap on files checked. Controls cost.
